categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: Tokenized Assets
categories.content: Tokenized products refers to digital representation of assets on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Real World Assets (RWA)
categories.content: Real World Assets (RWAs) refer to tangible or physical assets that have value in the real world. The tokenization of RWAs involves representing these assets digitally on a blockchain, allowing for fractional ownership, increased liquidity, and more efficient management and trading of these assets.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: BONK.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: LetsBONK.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via letsbonk.fun.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Robinhood Chain Stocks Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized securities and RWAs natively issued or managed within the Robinhood Chain infrastructure. Operating as a compliant, financial-grade scaling network under MiFID II guidelines, this ecosystem merges conventional stock portfolios with on-chain liquidity rails. The underlying architecture connects public equities, exchange-traded products, and private venture allocations directly to decentralized wallets while streaming economic benefits like dividend equivalents to verified asset holders.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Rollup
categories.content: Rollup is a layer 2 solution that aggregates and processes transactions outside of a main blockchain, before submitting them as a single batch, to enhance scalability and reduce fees.

categories.name: BackedFi xStocks Ecosystem
categories.content: xStocks refers to the tokenized stocks and ETFs issued by BackedFi.

categories.name: Sticker-Themed Coins
categories.content: Meme coins inspired by Telegram Sticker Packs

categories.name: Coinbase Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized U.S. equities issued by Coinbase and deployed on Base under its B20 tokenized equity standard, launched in 2026 for non-U.S. customers. Tokens are identified by a "C" suffix appended to the underlying ticker and can be traded onchain on DEXs.
